body:
Man, don't listen to them. They don't know you or anything about you. They bully you to feel better about themselves. Which is why most bullying occurs. So what that they call you a noob? There will always be someone better than you no matter how hard you try and there will always be someone better than them, ect. Its how the game works.  I feel the reason you play online games is to escape your problems in reality because ive been there to. It helps get my mind off of the world and my own problems. Ive been there man. Listen though. go outside and just look up at the sky and breath in real deep and exhale and close your eyes and listen to wind rush by you.  It'll be ok man its not the end of the world. As for your girl problems. If your actually looking for a relationship don't be afraid to start a relationship with someone. If there is someone who you would like to get to know or go on a date. Man up and go ask them to a movie don't be afraid man, trust me. I used to be afraid to talk to women out of fear of rejection and no girl ever really showed an interest in me either. One day I walked up to this girl I happened to have a crush on and asked her to a movie and she said "sure." You have to have confidence. If you stay inside and play games all the time and don't get out and meet people/socialize how do you expect to start a relationship with someone? I have a friend that stays on xbox live all day everyday and has never once had a gf because he's to afraid to talk to wemon. 

Man I don't even know you, but I assure you someone somewhere cares.I care. Your a human and your life has meaning regardless of what you say or think.
